_comment: Accepted BH/BHY rejection counts on the v3 daily-PIT panel, spec v3.0.
These are a property of THIS panel, not an invariant: the Array-era values
(track_a 12/11, track_b 0/0) were hard-coded in run_search_adjusted_fdr.py
and turned a legitimate universe rebuild into a crash. Counts live here so
that unintended drift trips a wire while a deliberate change is a one-line
edit with a reason.
Updated 2026-09-16 after two feature-basis fixes. The tripwire fired on
track_a BHY 11 -> 12, which is the intended behaviour: the change is real.
Updated 2026-09-17 after the corr_* source fix. The tripwire fired on
track_a BHY 12 -> 13, which is the intended behaviour: the change is real.
(3) corr_SPY/QQQ/XLK/XLY: the ETF leg of these 20-day return correlations
was aggregated from the 1-minute store with LAST(close) and no session
filter, so it was a post-market print (mean 11.9 bps, max 70.5 bps from
the official close) and the series ended 2025-07-31, leaving every
corr_* undefined over the forward window. They are daily features and
now take official closes from the same daily panel as the stocks.
All four ICs strengthen slightly on the cleaner basis (corr_SPY
-0.012 -> -0.014, corr_XLY -0.010 -> -0.012), and one more feature
clears the BHY threshold. BH is unchanged at 14; track_b is unchanged.
(1) vwap_dev: intraday VWAP came from raw 1-minute bars while the close
came from the split-adjusted daily panel, so the feature equalled
(1 - split factor) before every split. Both legs now come from the
same raw bars. The corrected feature is a genuine reversal signal and
is still selected, on honest data.
(2) overnight_gap: the tier-2 winsoriser rebuilt the close from clipped
returns but left open on the original basis, so every gap after a
ticker's first clipped day carried a constant factor. The whole bar is
now rescaled.
Source: results/staging/fdr_v3.log (2026-09-16), estimand = daily
cross-sectional Spearman IC over Screen 0 eligible names, null = stationary
block bootstrap (block 21, B=1000, seed 42), q=0.10.
Validity checks on the same estimand: placebo 0/10 rejected on both tracks;
5-day purged embargo leaves both selected sets unchanged (14 and 1).
